profile.headline: Fullstack Developer
profile.summary:
Hello, I'm Alejandro I'm a front end/fullstack developer with a passion for working on responsive front end using current technologies such as React but fully able to dig into the backend and do fullstack if necessary.

I previously worked at WB Mason as a fullstack developer where I developed and maintained the code for the ecommerce B2B website. My expertise is in fullstack technologies like SQL, Azure, Node JS, React, C#, etc, with a focus on responsive UI designs.

My interests are learning new technologies and keeping up to date with the latest AI updates and thinking of how I can integrate it into my current work. 

Outside of that I also enjoy tabletop, video games, and playing with my cute dog.
If any of this sounds like a match, feel free to reach out!

positions.description:
• Develop and maintain code base for ecommerce B2B website
    • Worked in agile sprint methodology with daily tasks and progress through azure sprint board
    • Collaborated with UX Designers and Project Managers to integrate customer feedback into UI enhancements
    • Collaborated with software developers in team of 5 with daily stand up for updates
    • Worked within multi-stack environment using Git, React frontend, ASP.Net Core backend, Javascript, Typescript, Docker, Postman, Webpack and SQL
    • Worked with engineer lead for performance improvements on systems
    • Documenting projects with goals, todos, technologies used, referenced projects, and API endpoints used
 • Transferred legacy C# code to modern Typescript/Javascript standards and integrate React/Redux for state management. Additionally worked with engineer lead on page performance improvements.

projects.title: Uma Stat Threshold Helper
projects.description:
• Custom calculator for helping determine optimized load-outs given user parameters
• Built with React front-end and Node.js backend. 
• TODO: Serve real results given user input, allow deck saving, data analytics using Plotly

projects.title: Netflix Recommendation App
projects.description:
• Webpage that is connected to a local LLM to get dynamic results and leverages react for dynamically loading data on the webpage.
• Custom made components with the goal of reusability use for the frontend.
• Working login/registration that saves credentials to SQL server; after logging in cookies user with expiration of 24 hours.
• Working chatbot leveraging LLM to provide responses.
• React Native implementation for mobile view
• Uses npm front end and node back end.
